From: coordinator@example.test
To: guest@example.test
Subject: Seating

Dear Ms. Lee, your group has been assigned the table by the stage. Please
arrive by six o'clock so that the photographer can take a group portrait.

[PASSAGE]
RIVERSIDE HALL — PARKING NOTICE

Guests arriving by car should use the north lot on Pine Street. A free shuttle
runs between the lot and the main entrance every fifteen minutes until ten
o'clock in the evening.

[QUESTION]
What is the purpose of the message?
(A) To give seating and arrival details
(B) To request a payment
(C) To cancel an event
(D) To offer a refund
Answer: A
Source: original

(C) Seven o'clock
(D) Eight o'clock

(D) A prize will be awarded.

Source: original

(A) Until 10 p.m.
(B) Until six o'clock
(C) Until noon
(D) Around the clock
Answer: A
